title: Electric shock and electrical burns
scenario: Person shocked by damaged wiring, outlet, or appliance. Electrical burn, was thrown, or is still in contact with the source.
steps: Do not touch the person while they may still be in contact with electricity.
Cut the power: unplug the device or switch off the breaker. If you cannot, call 911 and keep everyone away.
Once the power is confirmed off, check breathing. If not breathing, call 911 and start CPR.
Call 911 for any electrical burn — the visible mark can hide serious internal injury.
Cool visible burns with running water and cover loosely with a clean cloth.
Keep the person still and warm until help arrives.
do_not: Never use water on anything still connected to power.
Do not move the person unless they are in danger.
